paragraphs: The Sao Paulo Grand Prix will see outgoing World Champion Lando Norris start from pole for McLaren, with newly-crowned World Champion Kimi Antonelli alongside him for Mercedes. title: What the teams said – Race day at the 2026 Sao Paulo Grand Prix
paragraphs: Norris sealed his third win of the season and second in a row at Interlagos with a strong drive in tricky conditions. He was overtaken off the line and dropped to third, but once his tyres were up to temperature he started to motor forward. He was lucky to pick up the lead easily when Antonelli spun off, but from there did not put a foot wrong on a day where mistakes were easy to make.

title: Did Red Bull car problems cost Verstappen Brazilian GP victory?
paragraphs: Given that a flying Max Verstappen suddenly struggled with "an extreme amount of oversteer" after switching to slicks, did Red Bull car problems cost him the win at Formula 1's Brazilian Grand Prix?
